search_text: published ZDI-09-011 ZDI-CAN-391 Microsoft Internet Explorer CFunctionPointer Memory Corruption Vulnerability 2009-02-10 CVE-2009-0075 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-0075 ['Microsoft'] ['Internet Explorer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer.
